cells.location: Tiruvēḷaikkuḍi
cells.place: On the wall of the shrine in the Mangalēśvara temple †
cells.date:
2nd year, Mēsha, Sunday, Tiruvōgam. [date-calculation appendix, No. 136: 2nd year, Mēsha, Sunday, Tiruvōṇam.
The details are not sufficient for verification. On April 12, A.D. 969, a Sunday in the month of Mēsha, nak. Uttara-Āshāḍha was current till ·46
of the day and then Tiruvōṇam commenced ending at ·40 the next day.]
cells.remarks: Ends of lines built in. Records a remission of taxes on a land obtained by the assembly by purchase, by the assembly of Vidālvidungu-chaturvēdimangalam, for 50 kāsu received by them from a certain member of the Karikāla-sōlat-terinja-Kaikkōlar.

cells.location: Tiruvēḷaikkuḍi
cells.place: On the wall of the shrine in the Mangalēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Commences with the short introduction of the king beginning with the words Tirumanni valara. Records an agreement by the Sivabrāhmanas of the temple to provide offerings to the goddess of Tiruvēlvikkudi, as received by them, free of taxes, at Bhōkamangala-chaturvēdimangalam in the same nādu from Tiruvādi [Ira]yōri, evidently the lady mentioned in No. 134 above.

cells.location: Tiruvēḷaikkuḍi
cells.place: On the wall of the shrine in the Mangalēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: States that this stone was the gift of a certain Pattamōji Selvan.

cells.location: Tiruvilakkudi †
cells.place: On the wall of the shrine in the Mangalēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: States that Kachohuvan Kadan Uatti alias Tiruvayayu-yōgi of Nallūr-nādu founded the temple of the Nagariśvara at Kanjūra-nagaram, also built the Vidālvidungu-pallai of the temple at Tiruvēlvikkudi and supplied stones for the construction of tadipādal.

cells.location: Tiruvilakkudi †
cells.place: On the base of the north wall of the mandapa in front of the shrine in the Mangalēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Stones misplaced and some lost. Begins with the introduction Tirumanni valara, etc. Registers a sale of land as dēvadāna to Kadalanguḍi for feeding (the temple) by the assembly of Kadalanguḍi who received a sum towards the payment of the taxes on the land. They also agreed to maintain the feeding house on behalf of the temple and to supply red lilies to the god.

cells.location: Tiruvilakkudi †
cells.place: On the south wall of the mandapa in front of the shrine in the Mangalēśvara temple. †
cells.date: 16+1st year, Mīna, śu. Prathama, Sunday, Rēvati.
cells.remarks: Damaged and incomplete. Records the reconsecration of the images of Manavāla-Nambi. His consort and other deities in the temple by Śvetavanap[Perumāḷ] alias Topalainar who instituted a search for them and found out that they had been carried away and deposited in the village of [P]anaiyūr. The following is the name of the chief Vānakōvaraiyar in the 5th year of the reign of the king. He redeemed the images by payment of money and after consecration made provision for their offerings and worship.

cells.location: Tiruvilakkudi †
cells.place: On the wall of the mandapa in front of the shrine in the Mangalēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: States that the mandapa was built by Madavan Tiruvāran-gadēvan alias Gangaikondachōla-Visaiyāyalap of Kadalanguḍi.

cells.location: Tiruvēḷaikkuḍi
cells.place: On the wall of the mandapa in front of the shrine in the Mangalēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Records an agreement by the Sivabrāhmanas of the temple of Manavāla-Nambi at Tiruvēlvikkudi in Kurukkai-nādu, a subdivision of Virudarājabhayankara-valanādu, to burn a twilight lamp from the interest on the money received by them from a resident of Kadalanguḍi alias Gangaikondachōla-chaturvēdimangalam.

cells.location: Tiruvilakkudi †
cells.place: On the north wall of the Natarāja shrine in the Mangalēśvara temple. †
cells.date: 4th year, Makara, ba. shashti, Sunday, Hasta.
cells.remarks: Records a remission of taxes for 20 kāsu received from the temple at Tiruvēlvikkudi by the assembly of Pugalōkamānikka-chaturvēdimangalam on a land purchased for the founding of a temple to Tirukkēdara-lingam in the village by a certain Alagiyāśikan-Uyyavandān alias Jñānāśiyar of Pūndi in Paravai-nādu a division of Rājarāja-valanādu, who was a tapasvin attached to the temple.

cells.location: Tiruvilakkudi †
cells.place: On the wall of the Natarāja shrine in the Mangalēśvara temple †
cells.date: 4th year, Makara, ba. shashti, Sunday, Hasta.
cells.remarks: Registers a sale of land, free of taxes, for 90 kāsu by the same assembly to Jñānāśiyar mentioned above, who endowed it for worship and offerings to the god Tirukkēdaram and for feeding the Mahēśvaras visiting the temple on pilgrimage.

cells.location: Tiruvilakkudi †
cells.place: On the wall of the Natarāja shrine in the Mangalēśvara temple †
cells.date: 5th year, Kanya, śu. daśami, Wednesday, Tiruvōṇam.
cells.remarks: Registers a similar sale of land free of taxes by the same assembly for 1 kāśu to the same donor who parchased it for offerings in the temple of Tirukkadāram and for feeding the Māhésvaras coming for worship and for the maintenance of those reciting (?) the Vodas and Śastras in the temple.

cells.location: Tiruvilakkudi †
cells.place: On the south wall of the Vighrēśvara shrine in the Natarāja shrine in the Mangalēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Registers a sale of land by Śrikarapa-Pichchaṇ for 24½ kalūṇju to a lady named Baladévaṇ-llangai Śonai who placed it in his own charge for burning a perpetual lamp to the god Vighnésvara in the temple.

cells.location: Tiruvilakkudi †
cells.place: Near the dēvapratiṣṭha image on the right side in the Vighrēśvara shrine in the Natarāja shrine in the Mangalēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Records that the three stones (of the wall) were each the gift of three members of the 'Gaṇdarā-[di*]jochcha-teriṇja-Kaikko]ar.'

cells.location: Tiruvilakkudi †
cells.place: Near the other dēvapratiṣṭha image, on the left side.
cells.remarks: States that Kari Veppan alias Karikālamma Moṭṭa-Vaḷan of Aṇiyam in Teṇkarai-nāḍu got the image of the Mahā kalēṣa made (for the temple).

cells.location: Tiruvilakkudi †
cells.place: Near the other dēvapratiṣṭha image, on the left side. †
cells.remarks: States that door-post was made by Periyakilavan-dēvan, a writer of the Kōyil-kēḷvi (Revenue Department).

cells.location: Tiruvilakkudi †
cells.place: On the south wall of the kitchen in the Vighrēśvara shrine in the Natarāja shrine in the Mangalēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Beginning of lines built in. Commences with the introduction [śrī]kāryam... etc. Seems to record a gift of money and utensils to the god Periyadēva and his consort set up in the temple of [Maga]yāḷ-Nambi.

cells.location: Kachanam, Tirutturaipūṇḍi taluk
cells.place: On the base of the west wall of the central shrine in the Karachinhēśvarasvāmi temple
cells.remarks: Damaged. Registers a remission of taxes granted to the chaturvēdimangalam on the land in the village named after Mattaradar in Kūchchiyūru, a division of Vaḍakal Vaṇḍājai vēḷar-kūṟṟam in Rājēndraśiṅga-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.location: Kachanam, Tirutturaipūṇḍi taluk †
cells.place: On the north base of the maṇḍapa in front of the shrine in the Karachinhēśvarasvāmi temple. †
cells.date: Śaka 1342, Mosha, śu. daśami, Friday, Uttiram.
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of a house-site and land to Śira[nda]perun[a] alias Kongurvaṇ Vetive]laṇ of Uttarangudi, a division of Vanpo]nūcheri-kuṇram in Rajendrasōla-vulanaṇu.

cells.location: Kachanam, Tirutturaipūṇḍi taluk †
cells.place: On the base of the east wall of the mahā-maṇḍapa in front of the shrine in the Karachinhēśvarasvāmi temple. †
cells.date: 29 + 1st year, Vriscchika, ba. navami, Sunday, Hasta.
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of lands in different places by Ayalay Tirumalaikkaḍaiyān of Madurō-daya-vaḷanāḍu, a subdivision of Chōḷa-Pāṇḍya-maṇḍalam in Pāṇḍy-nāḍu to the dēvakaṇmis of the temple of Paṇḍy-nāḍu-nāyanār for burning two perpetual lamps for the merit of the donor and for offerings and worship daily and on festival days in the months of Margali and Vaikāśi.

cells.location: Kachanam, Tirutturaipūṇḍi taluk †
cells.place: On the base of the east and north walls of the maṇḍapa in front of the shrine in the Karachinhēśvarasvāmi temple. †
cells.date: 10th year, Dhanus, śu. Wednesday, Rēvati. [date-calculation appendix, No. 155: 10th year, Dhanus, śu. Wednesday, Aśvati = A.D, 1286, December 25, Wednesday ; ·67. The tithi was navami which was current the whole day and ended at ·02 the next day.]
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of land to the dévakaṇmis of the Tirukkachchiṇam-udaiya-Nayaṇar temple by Késava-Bhatṭaṇ, son of comadéva Bhatṭaṇ of Mudumbsi in Siruki]or alias Mudima[n]tambiraṇ-chaturvēdimangalam, an agrahāra in Vanda]lai--Velūr-kuṇram, for the celebration of the Vasanta festival in the month of Vaikaśi.

cells.location: Kachanam, Tirutturaipūṇḍi taluk †
cells.place: On the base of the north wall of the Konganēśvarasvāmi shrine in the Karachinhēśvarasvāmi temple. †
cells.remarks: Registers an agreement given by three priests to burn a perpetual lamp in the temple for 50 kāsu received by them from Arangay-Ātkondān, the headman of Peru . . . .

cells.location: Kachanam, Tirutturaipūṇḍi taluk †
cells.place: On the base of the north wall of the Konganēśvarasvāmi shrine in the Karachinhēśvarasvāmi temple †
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of a sum of money by a certain lady Annadāna-Nangai, from the interest on which a twilight lamp had to be burnt in the temple.

cells.location: Kachanam, Tirutturaipūṇḍi taluk †
cells.place: On the base of the south and east walls of the shrine in the Karachinhēśvarasvāmi temple. †
cells.remarks: Gives a list of the lands belonging to the temple in different villages. Refers to the 40th year of Periyadēvar Kulōttunga-Chōḷadēva.

cells.location: Kachanam, Tirutturaipūṇḍi taluk †
cells.place: On the base of the south, east and north walls of the shrine in the Karachinhēśvarasvāmi temple. †
cells.remarks: Stones of order. Begins with the introduction of the Sundara-chōla-dēva. Records an agreement by the Sivabrāhmanas of the temple to burn a perpetual lamp before the god at Tirakkachchayam in Arvalak-kūrram, a division of Rājēndra-valanādu, for the 100 kāsu received by them from a certain individual.

cells.location: Kachanam, Tirutturaipūṇḍi taluk †
cells.place: On the base of the north wall of the shrine in the Karachinhēśvarasvāmi temple. †
cells.remarks: Registers another agreement by the Sivabrāhmanas to burn a perpetual lamp before the god, by turns, for the 100 kāsu received by them from the accountant of the temple.

cells.location: Kachanam, Tirutturaipūṇḍi taluk †
cells.place: On the base of the north wall of the shrine in the Karachinhēśvarasvāmi temple †
cells.remarks: Ends of lines 1-4 are lost. Registers a similar agreement to burn a lamp for the amount received from Tillaināyakan-Aludaiyān of Ariyalūr.

cells.location: Kachanam, Tirutturaipūṇḍi taluk
cells.place: On the base of the north wall of the shrine in the Karachinhēśvarasvāmi temple †
cells.date: 40th year, Mitbuṇa, šu. ashṭami, Wednesday, Hasta.
cells.remarks: Another agreement by the Sivabrāhmanas to burn a lamp before the god for 2,200 kāsu received by them from a resident of Kuchchagam named Vīna-Nāyaka of Se[kal].

cells.location: Pannateru, same taluk and district
cells.place: On the base of the north wall of the shrine in the Karachinhēśvarasvāmi temple †
cells.remarks: Another agreement by the Sivabrāhmanas to burn a perpetual lamp for 400 kāsu received by them, from an oil-monger named Vīna-Nāyaka of Se[kal].

cells.place: On the south wall of the same shrine.
cells.remarks: Another agreement by the Sivabrāhmanas of the temple of god Pannagābharaṇasvara to burn a lamp in the temple from the interest on 1,300 kāsu received by them from Tiruvēngadadēvan alias Gangaikonda-Vēḷar of Tinuvāśchiyam in Kulōttunga-chōla-valanādu.

cells.location: Sittambur, same taluk and district
cells.place: On the south wall of the shrine in the Pannagābharaṇasvāmi temple. †
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Seems to register the agreement made by the Sivabrāhmanas to provide the daily expenses and to burn a twilight lamp in the temple for the interest on 150 kāsu received by them from certain persons.

cells.place: On the same base
cells.remarks: Damaged at the end. Seems to register a gift of money for burning a lamp in the temple of Sittambur.

cells.location: Sittambur, Tirutturaipūṇḍi taluk, Tanjore district ‡ — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall of the shrine in the Svarnasthānēśvarasvāmi temple. †
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Registers the agreement by the Sivabrāhmaṇas of the temple to burn a perpetual lamp for the money received by them from a certain individual.

cells.location: Sittambur, Tirutturaipūṇḍi taluk, Tanjore district ‡ — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a stone lying in the north prākāra of the Svarnasthānēśvarasvāmi temple. †
cells.remarks: In modern characters. Damaged at the end. States that the 25 vēli of land in Alanguḍi belongs to the god (Tumbiarar) at Tiruvāymiyūr.

cells.location: Pānaiyāṫṭūr, Mannargudi taluk, Tanjore district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south base of the maṇḍapa in front of the central shrine in the Nāganāthasvāmī temple
cells.remarks: Registers a sale of land belonging to the temple of Tirup-pādalēśvaram-Udaiyār to Muḍaliyar Pillai Vāgiśapuram of Vadakkimūl-um of Selva-iruravaraindār. Another piece of writing contains the name Alaiaḍaiyārunda-śirappam.

cells.location: Pānaiyāṫṭūr, Mannargudi taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north wall of the mahāmaṇḍapa in the Nāganāthasvāmī temple. †
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Mentions [Pām*]bunīk-kūram in Suṭṭavali-vaṙanādu.

cells.location: Pānaiyāṫṭūr, Mannargudi taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of the mahāmaṇḍapa in the Nāganāthasvāmī temple †
cells.remarks: Fragment. Seems to register a gift of 96 sheep for a perpetual lamp to the god Sribhūti-Viṇṇagar-Alvar.

cells.location: Pānaiyāṫṭūr, Mannargudi taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall of the maṇḍapa in front of the central shrine in the Nāganāthasvāmī temple. †
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Seems to register a gift of sheep. Men-tions Uḍaiyan Kāḍan Nāṟramaṇi.

cells.location: Pānaiyāṫṭūr, Mannargudi taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Inside the gopura of the Nāganāthasvāmī temple right of entrance. †
cells.date: 6th year, Simha, ba. dvadasti, Satur-day, Puṣam.
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of land by Gangaiyādar, daughter of Vilap-purāyar, for worship to the image of the god set up by her, and for the Ahividdhi-apparund-sūndi in the temple of Tirupputtalaippūr at Muttāru-kūrram.

cells.location: Pānaiyāṫṭūr, Mannargudi taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a broken pillar lying outside the Nāganāthasvāmī temple. †
cells.remarks: Mentions a desire to register a gift of money for feeding a devotee daily in the temple of Srībhūti-Viṇṇagar. The characters belong to the 10th century A.D.

cells.location: Mahādēvapattanam, Mannargudi taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a stone lying in the Svēta-varāha-Perumāl temple
cells.date: Śaka 1650, Kilaka, Śravaṇa, śu. pratipad, Friday.
cells.remarks: Contains a list of names of gods and goddesses to whom obeisance is offered. The date portion is in the Mahraṭhi language.

cells.location: Tiruchohirampalam, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the base of the north wall of the central shrine in the Panu-manavānīśvara temple
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of land by the king to the temple of Tiruvaichobhi-Iśvaram-Udaiyar, and a grant of lands, etc., to Valiyān-Ugaṇḍaiyār who hears a number of burden.

cells.location: Tiruchohirampalam, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the base of the north and west walls of the shrine in the Panu-manavānīśvara temple. †
cells.date: Śaka 1425 (mistake for 1525), Śobha-krit, Chittirai 28, ba. dasāmī, Sudaiyam, Monday. Pīngala, Kartitkai, 5. [date-calculation appendix, No. 177: Śāka 1425 (mistake for 1525), Śōbhakrit, Chittirai 28, ba. daśami, Sataiyam Monday = A.D. 1603, April 25, Monday ; ·83; ·25.]
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of the residents of Śaṅkamangalam to Am balattaḍam-Tambirān for conducting the abhi-shēka of the god Pañchāksharanātha-Tambiranar and for worship during early morning.

cells.location: Tiruchohirampalam, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the base of the west wall of the shrine in the Panu-manavānīśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Registers the decision of the assembly of Siruvayal extol-ling the ēttarainādu land belonging to the god Pañaiya-vanap-Perumāl, and to include the others for purposes of taxation.

cells.location: Tiruchohirampalam, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the base of the south wall of the shrine in the Panu-manavānīśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Registers a grant of tax-free land as kudininga-dēvadāna made by the assembly of the village Iḷaiyūr to the god in the same shrine.

cells.location: Tiruchohirampalam, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the base of the south wall of the shrine in the Panu-manavānīśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Registers a sale of some land by the Sāmanta Malavarāyan for 100 paṇam as dēvadāna to the god Palaiya-vaṇa-Perumāḷ in Vaṭṭāru-nāḍu in Paṅgūḷ-kūṟṟam, a sub-division of Rājarāja-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.location: Tiruchohirampalam, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the base of the south wall of the shrine in the Panu-manavānīśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Registers a grant of the village Punaivāsel as sareamānya to the god by Palĵikondaperumaī Malavarāyar.

cells.location: Tiruchohirampalam, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the base of the south wall of the shrine in the Panu-manavānīśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Registers a grant of land for worship to the goddess at Tiruchchiṟṟambalam by Kuḷōttuṅga-Śeṭṭi, a horse-dealer of Muḷai-maṇḍalam.

cells.location: Tiruchohirampalam, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north base of the maṇḍapa in front of the shrine in the Panu-manavānīśvara temple. †
cells.date:
Śaka 1425 (mistake for 1525), Śōbhakrit, Chittirai 28, ba. daṣami, Śadaiyam, Monday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 183: Śāka 1425 (evidently a mistake for ś. 1525), Śobhakrit, Chittirai 28, ba. daśami, Saṭaiyam, Monday.  
Details same as for No. 177 in the previous page.]
cells.remarks: Registers a sale of land to the person mentioned in No. 177 above, by the residents of Āvaṇi in Vaḍahāra-nāḍu for 80 eśaiṣiḍāḍu-chakkaraṃ-poṇ.

cells.location: Tiruchchirṇrambalam, Pattukkottai taluk, Pudukkottai district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same base
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Seems to register a gift to god Palaiya-vaṇa-nātha at Tiruchchiṟṟambalam, by Vīrarāghava-Nāyaka, son of Sēūji Liṅgama-Nāyaka.

cells.location: Tiruchohirampalam, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the base of the maṇḍapa in front of the shrine in the Panu-manavānīśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Mentions tirunōbhiraṇṇam.

cells.location: Tiruchohirampalam, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the right door-jumb of the same entrance.
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Mentions the god T.ruchchiṟṟambattu.

cells.location: Tiruchohirampalam, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the right door-jumb of the entrance into the Ayyarvar temple. †
cells.remarks: Registers a remission of taxes by the assembly of Kuḷakkuḍi in Puṉṟi-kūṟṟam, for a lump amount received by them from Uttamuḍaiyār, of Veḷuvūr and its utilisation for offerings to the god at Tiruchchiṟṟambalam, a dēvadāna-brahmadēya of Iḷaiyūr-nāḍu.

cells.location: Tiruchohirampalam, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a pillar in the maṇḍapa in front of the shrine in the Panu-manavānīśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to register the provision made for burning a twilight lamp to god Mahādēva of Tiruchchiṟṟambalam, a dēvadāna-brahmadēya of Puṉṟi-kūṟṟam.

cells.remarks: Incomplete. Registers a grant of land for digging a channel to feed the tank in the dēvadāna village of Tiruchchiṟṟambalam.

cells.location: Tiruchohirampalam, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a pillar in a room in the maṇḍapa in front of the shrine in the Panu-manavānīśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Highly damaged. Registers a gift of sheep for a lamp by a woman called Nakkaṉ-Nāchoṇi on behalf of her daughter.

cells.location: Tiruchohirampalam, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a pillar in the maṇḍapa in front of the Ammaṉ shrine in the Panu-manavānīśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: States that the pillar was the gift of Mīḷi-kāma-iḷamai alias Madiyālpuraiyar.

cells.location: Tiruchohirampalam, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the west wall of the kitchen in the Ammaṉ shrine in the Panu-manavānīśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Fragment. Seems to register a gift of land to the temple by Udaiyūn-Araṅgalvān alias Kudirai-Āndān of Neṭuvāyil, who also made some additions to the building.

cells.location: Tiruchohirampalam, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a pillar in the western verandah round the central shrine in the same temple.
cells.remarks: Fragment. Seems to register a gift of land for providing offerings to the god at Tiruchchiṟṟambalam, a dēvadāna-brahmadēya of Puṉṟi-kūṟṟam.

cells.location: Tiruchohirampalam, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south base of the central shrine in the Saundarēśvarasvāmī temple at Kovilkadu, hamlet of Attivetti, same taluk.
cells.date: 9+1st year, Siṁha, ba. chaturthī, Sūnday, Āsvaiv.
cells.remarks: Registers an undertaking by Periyan Alagiyaperumān alias Sōlagaṅgan of Palaiyūr in Palaiyūr-nāḍu sub-division of Miḷalaikūṛram to sell (vittukkoṇḍu) un-maḍi (ḍi) kkuśu and to releve the land from mundalki-not to relese new taxes besides 600 kuli and 2 kuliom of paddy on every maï leviable on the lands in his charge, (excluding those given tax-free for the mainte-nance of mathas and brahmaṇas).

cells.location: Tiruchohirampalam, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the west base of the Tyāgarājasvāmī temple at Vikramam, Madukur Zamindari, same taluk.
cells.date: 16th year, Makara, śu. tritiya, Sunday, Aviṭtam.
cells.remarks: A resolution by the residents and the big assembly regarding certain taxes to be levied on certain taxes only on lands and not on persons and houses.

cells.location: Mutta-kuriōchi, Pattukottai taluk †
cells.place: On the west wall of the deserted Siva temple
cells.remarks: Damaged at the end. Seems to register a sarvamānya grant of land for keeping watch over the villages Maduk-kōr, Veppangulam and Muttakurichichi in the troublous times following Kōṇerirajar's flight from Trichinopoly in the year Nala.

cells.location: Sembalai, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a beam in the maṇḍapa in front of the Amman shrine in the Agniśvara temple
cells.remarks: Records that Krishnappayyan, son of Vangara[śu] Chennappayyan built the nritta-mandapa and the sikhara of the Parimāla-Nachchiyar shrine and made a gift of lands for providing offerings to the god and his consort and for maintaining lamps in the temple.

cells.location: Sembalai, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north wall of the central shrine in the Sundarēśvaram temple in the same village (as Amman shrine). †
cells.remarks: Gives the daily scale of expenses in the temple of god Tiruppurandarāsvāmi at Chandraśēkhari-chaturvēdimangalam, a brahmadeya in Arkaṭṭu-kūṛram, which had to be maintained from the land granted from the Puṅgaruikkai in Po-mai-nāḍu. The record belongs to the 10th century A.D.

cells.location: Sembalai, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of the central shrine in the Sundarēśvaram temple in the same village (as Sundarēśvaram temple) †

cells.location: Sembalai, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the base of the wall of the central shrine in the Sundarēśvaram temple in the same village (as Sundarēśvaram temple) †
cells.remarks: Records that Omaindan Nārāyaṇan Annaian of Kaṇḍiyūr received some money and that from the interest on it a lamp had to be burnt before the god in the Druparddhaurālai in Chandraśēkharam-chaturvēdimangalam, a division of Ark-kaṭṭu-kūṛram.

cells.location: Sembalai, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the base of the wall of the central shrine in the Sundarēśvaram temple in the same village (as Sundarēśvaram temple) †
cells.remarks: End lost. Mentions that the śribali ceremony in the temple of god Purandurai-Uḍaiyar was stopped owing to the absence of the dēvakaṇmis, and that the land appertaining to the service of the drūmākāra was transferred to one Arakaṭṭu-kūṛram is said to have formed a certain division of Paṇḍikulāsani-vaṙnādu.

cells.location: Sembalai, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of the shrine in the Sundarēśvaram temple in the same village (as Sundarēśvaram temple) †
cells.remarks: Gives the details of daily expenditure to be incurred in the temple from 30 kālam of paddy per annum obtained from the dēvadāna village Paṙnāgu in Peyguai-nādu.

cells.location: Sembalai, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the base of the wall of the shrine in the Sundarēśvaram temple in the same village (as Sundarēśvaram temple) †

Near the inscription is a fragmentary record of Raja-kesarivarman 'who destroyed the ships at Sālai' dated in the 13th year.

cells.location: Sembalai, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall of the shrine in the Sundarēśvaram temple in the same village (as Sundarēśvaram temple), †
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of gold by Kudālagi Bāladevan of Penni-kudi in Agakkiliyūr-nādu, for burning a perpetual lamp before the god.

cells.location: Sembalai, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of the shrine in the Sundarēśvaram temple in the same village (as Sundarēśvaram temple), †

cells.remarks: Incomplete. Mentions Narasa-Nāyaka and Veṅkaiyar-Mudali, son of Raṅganātha of Kaveripakkam in Toṇḍai-maṇḍalam.

cells.remarks: Registers the grant made by Viraiya Daṇḍanāyaka-Uḍaiyar to secure victory to the king and to himself, of a sarva-mānya land (for the expenses) of the god when the image of the deity was taken during festivities to the maṇḍapa in the Sūryanārāyana-kōppu.

cells.remarks: Incomplete. Enumerates the conquests of the king and registers the remission of the taxes such as jōḍi, śōlavari and arasupēru due from the Vishnu and Śiva temples in Sōlamandalam including those at Śendalai. See A.R. 1925 26, page 89.

cells.location: Sembalai, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu

cells.location: Kīḻappaluvūr, Uḍaiyārpālaiyam taluk, Trichinopoly district — Tamil Nadu

cells.location: Sembalai, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu

cells.remarks: Registers a gift of 90 sheep by the residents (nāṭṭār) of Kuṇrak-kūṛṛam for maintaining a perpetual lamp before god Mahādēva-uḍaiyār.

cells.location: Kīḻappaluvūr, Uḍaiyārpālaiyam taluk, Trichinopoly district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of the central shrine in the Paśupatīśvara-svāmi temple in the same village (as Paśupatīśvara-svāmi temple), Uḍaiyarpalaiyam taluk, Trichinopoly district †

cells.location: Sembalai, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu

cells.location: Kīlappaluvūr, Udayar Palayam taluk, Tiruchirappalli district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall of the shrine in the Paśupatīśvara-svāmi temple in the same village (as Paśupatīśvara-svāmi temple), Uḍaiyarpalaiyam taluk, Trichinopoly district. †

cells.remarks: Damaged. Appears to relate to a similar gift.

cells.location: Sembalai, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu

cells.remarks: Incomplete. Seems to register a gift of land by the wise of Adigal Paļuvēttaraiyar Kandan-Maravan for offerings to the god during the three services of the day.

cells.location: Kīḻappaluvūr, Uḍaiyārpālaiyam taluk, Trichinopoly district — Tamil Nadu

cells.remarks: Records that the oummander Nekkan-Sattan of Para-dūr made a gift of 90 sheep for maintaining a perpetual lamp in the temple of Tiruvalandurai-Mahādeva at Sirupuliyūr in Kuppa-kūram to commemorate the victory of Paluvettaraiyar Kāndan-Amudanār when the Pāndy king (Panjey-nāduu) Ceylon-nese army attacked the Chōla king at the battle-field and the king died. An additional provision was made for other lamps to be burnt every month on certain specified days including that of Punarpūsam, the nalai stai of Amudanār.

cells.place: On the wall of the shrine in the Vațamūlevāra-svāmi temple in the same village (as Alagiya-maṇavāla-Perumāḷ temple) †
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of sheep by Araiyan Dēvan of Maṇarkudi in Krum-puliyūr in Poygai-nādu for burning a lamp in the temple.

cells.location: Kīḻappaluvūr, Uḍaiyārpālaiyam taluk, Trichinopoly district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of the shrine in the Vațamūlevāra-svāmi temple in the same village (as Alagiya-maṇavāla-Perumāḷ temple) †
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of 90 sheep for burning a perpetual lamp in the temple by Adigaņilavi of Shrakkūdi in Idaiyāṛ-ruppattu.

cells.location: Kīḻappaluvūr, Uḍaiyārpālaiyam taluk, Trichinopoly district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of the shrine in the Vațamūlevāra-svāmi temple in the same village (as Alagiya-maṇavāla-Perumāḷ temple) †
cells.remarks: Registers a similar gift for a lamp by Na[k*]kan-Kādaran of Tañjāvūr.

cells.location: Kīḻappaluvūr, Uḍaiyārpālaiyam taluk, Trichinopoly district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of the shrine in the Vațamūlevāra-svāmi temple in the same village (as Alagiya-maṇavāla-Perumāḷ temple) †
cells.remarks: Registers a similar gift by Nandin-Kadeitti, a maid (pendātti) of the household (ve]tam) of Gaṇapadarādhar of Tañjāvūr.

cells.location: Kīḻappaluvūr, Uḍaiyārpālaiyam taluk, Trichinopoly district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of the shrine in the Vațamūlevāra-svāmi temple in the same village (as Alagiya-maṇavāla-Perumāḷ temple) †
cells.remarks: Built at the end. Registers a sale of land to the temple by Sāvanti Dāmodaran Korran, a brahman of Sirupuli-yūr in Kuppakūram.

cells.location: Sembalai, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the base of the north wall of the mandapa in front of the shrine in the Mangalēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Built in the beginning and in the middle. Commences with the introduction Sigar cirae, etc. Registers a sale of land to the temple by Balasiriyan Irāvi-Iravi of Sațțamangalam, Kiran Lakkavaņaŋ and Kādan Ponnadai, wife of Savandi Nārāyaṇan-Sūdaiyan of Sigapuliyūr in Utungatunga-vaļanādu.

cells.location: Sembalai, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall of the mandapa in front of the shrine in the Mangalēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Registers a grant of land as devadāna by Māravan-Nambi for offerings to the god Tiruvalandurai-Mahādeva on the day of Uttarāyana-saṁkrānti and for offerings to the god Ganapati on the day of Tiruvōgam in the month of Poụiyāri.

cells.location: Sembalai, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of the mandapa in front of the shrine in the Mangalēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Registers a gift of sheep and land by Kānti-yapp-Māravan of Manigai-nādu, for the supply of ghee to the temple on the day of Uttarāyana-saṁkrānti. Mentions Paluvettaraiyar Maravan-Kandan as having built this temple.

cells.location: Kīḻappaluvūr, Uḍaiyārpālaiyam taluk, Trichinopoly district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of the mandapa in front of the shrine in the Mangalēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction Vegase, etc. Regis-tera gift of 32 cows by Sōttamallan Sōlakulāntakan alias Gangaikondachōla-Vāśkōvaṇaiyan for burning a perpetual lamp in the temple.

cells.location: Sembalai, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the base of the wall of the mandapa in front of the shrine in the Mangalēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of 90 sheep for burning a perpetual lamp in the temple by Nattaganjēyal-Nangai, wife of a certain Venā-Udaiyar.

cells.location: Sembalai, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the base of the wall of the mandapa in front of the shrine in the Mangalēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Beginning built in. Registers a sale of land to the temple by Sāvandi Nārāyaṇan Sūdan of Siņapuliyūr.

cells.location: Sembalai, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the east wall of the mandapa in front of the shrine in the Mangalēśvara temple, right of entrance. †
cells.remarks: End built in. Records that Paluvettaraiyar Maravan-Kandunapar purchased lands in Podarkudi alias Tiruvalan-kurram and assigned portions to several persons for service and for burning a lamp before god Mahadevaṇāra-rattu-Dēvar.

cells.location: Sembalai, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.remarks: Registers a grant of 1½ kalāñju of gold and three kalam of paddy to a certain Alayörch-Chakkai to enact three scenes of the tākkaik-küttu on the Aśvati day of the festivals in the month of Arpaśi at Tiruvalandurainallor.

cells.location: Sembalai, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.date: Mallikarjunaraya, son of Vira-Devaraya-Maharaya. [date-calculation appendix, No. 251: Śaka 1368, Kshaya, Karkaṭaka, śu. dvādaśī, Friday, Uttiram. On Friday, July 1, A.D. 1445, the tithi was śu. 7·28 but the nak. was Hasta which was current till ·10 of the day.]
cells.language: Śaka 13[6]8, Khaya, Karka-taka, śu. dvadaśi, Friday, Uttiram.
cells.remarks: Registers a remission of 30 poñ granted by Mahamandaleśvara Vitṇmaśola-Maharaja to the nātilavar of Paluvörparru, Konrapparru and Ugaljör-pairru in Uttunga-valanađa, who had hitherto been paying 90 poñ annually as kāpikkai (tax).

cells.location: Sembalai, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of the village Pūnchörrukudi, as sarva-mānya by Mallaraśar-Daṇayakkar-Udaiyar for providing daily offerings to the god, burning sacred lamps in the temple, and for offerings to the deity when the image was taken on festival days to Daṇayakka-Udaiyar-mandapa.

cells.location: Sembalai, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.remarks: End built in. Registers an agreement relating to social conduct among the Valangai and Idangai sects of 2 out of 18 subdivisions around Pennparpi in Irungolappandi-valanađa in Merkai-nađu, a division of Virudaraja-bhayańkara-valanađu on the northern bank of the Kaveri, who had assembled in the temple of Tiruvalandurai-Mahādevar.

cells.location: Sembalai, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.remarks: Records that, on the request made by Gangeyarayar and Chedirayar, the king was pleased to order the separation in the accounts under the name of Kajarajan-Sirukkappamangalam at Palavûr in Kunrapparru of Kunrak-kürram, 250 vēli of land in Karuppur in Konrak-körram, a division of Uttungatonga-valanađu bought by Pogalān of Sirukapamangalam in Uraiyör-nađu, a division of Rajagambhira-valanađu.

cells.location: Sembalai, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.remarks: Damaged at the beginning. Seems to register the provision made to burn lights in the night, till the tirukkāppu with the ghee and rice obtained on Sundays (from devotees).

cells.location: Sembalai, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.remarks: Unfinished. Seems to register a sale of land made by the assembly of Sirupalvūr to a resident of Pūnchörrûr in Kilar-kürram, a sub-division of Nittavinōda-valanađu.

cells.location: Sembalai, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.remarks: Registers an order of the king at the request of Pallavarajān, to the tenants of several villages in Uttunga-valanađu alias Kunrak-kürram, fixing the scale of taxes leviable from their lands.

cells.location: Sembalai, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.remarks: Registers that Mōgan-Āndatiru, wife of Virrirundan Pānchanedi of this village, gave away some lands belonging to her husband and his brother which had become her property after their death, for the expenses of providing unguents to the image of Tiruvalandurai-udaiya-Nāyaṇar.

cells.location: Sembalai, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of the mandapa in front of the shrine in the Mangalēśvara temple, right of entrance †
cells.remarks: Registers the royal order issued at the instance of Pallava-rāyar to the residents of Uțungatunga-valanādu grant-ing to the temple the exclusive right of cultivating the land to now main, free from taxes, the villages of the included Varanasi, Sirugaiyūr, Kallagam, Tu[da]ri and Kurufjippādi.

cells.location: Sembalai, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a slab lying in the south side of the second prākāra, Mangalēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: In modern characters. States that the garden with the pond belonging to the god at Alandurai was the gift of a certain Kurunāļaiyan.

cells.location: Sembalai, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the east wall of the prākāra of the Svarnasthānēśvarasvāmi temple, left of entrance. †
cells.remarks: Built in the middle by the Vināyaka shrine. Begins with the introduction gesari, etc. Records that, on a representation made by Aravapāri Paṇankāļi Vānukovaraiyan, on a representation by the temple authorities, the dēvadāna lands were sufficient for offerings to the god, the king, when he was seated on the throne under the pearl canopy in the abhiśhēka-mantapa at Vikkirama-sõlapuram, made a gift of more land, free of taxes, in Tiruchchiramballur nice Ariudamari-Kilandur in Poygai-nādu, a sub-division of Tribhuvanamududai-valanādu.

cells.location: Sembalai, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the west wall of the Vinayaka shrine near the tank in the same village (as Svarnasthānēśvarasvāmi temple). †
cells.remarks: In modern characters. States that the dilapidated prākāra of the Pillaiyār shrine was repaired by the people '(of the village).'

cells.location: Sembalai, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a pillar in the maṇdapa in front of the tank near the Vinayaka shrine. †
cells.remarks: In characters of the 15th century. States that this maṇdopa was constructed by Iravi-Maniyan cies Sembiyadaraiyan of Sembiyam who had property at Vengagār.

cells.location: Sembalai, Pattukottai taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a stone lying in a field at Tenkadu near the same village (as Vinayaka shrine). †
cells.remarks: In modern characters. Registers the gift of a field by Oppilīdan Maļavarāyar, son of Rān.appa-Maļavarāyar, for a charity.

cells.location: Periya-korukkai, Lalgudi taluk, Trichinopoly district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall of the Sundarēśvara temple
cells.remarks: Registers a gift, by purchase, of the village Tattan-kupiechi in Kaikākiliyn-nādu by Sūriyan Malagi-haļanđan Teṇnavaraiyan of Kurukkai in Uruppidān-nādu, a subdivision of Vadakarai Rājarāja-vaļanādu, for repairs and for the images of Alaġiyasōkka-Nayinār and his consort, which he had set up in the temple.

cells.location: Periya-korukkai, Lalgudi taluk, Trichinopoly district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of the Sundarēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Registers the order of Māyidēvanar, son of Mahā-maṇḍalēśvara Kulōttuṅgaśōļa Sōmanātharaiyan, fixing the taxes on the lands, both wet and dry, belonging to the temple of Alagiyasōkka-Nāyinār at Periyakorukkai, including the one mentioned in the previous inscription.

cells.location: Periya-korukkai, Lalgudi taluk, Trichinopoly district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south and east walls of the Sundarēśvara temple. †
cells.date: 27th year and 28th year, Kumbha, du. tritiyā, Fri-day, Uttirāshādi.
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of land by Sokkan Maṇalālandan Sena-varaiyan for providing worship to the god and for repairs to the temple.

cells.location: Periya-korukkai, Lalgudi taluk, Trichinopoly district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the east wall of the Sundarēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: A few letters are missing at the end. Registers the appointment of Ambalidāyan Kuñjaramallan alias Aruṇamolināthan as the temple-watchman of the temple at Kuṟuṅkai in ‘Uṟaiyūṟkūṟṟam, a subdivision of Rājarāja-vaṉādu on the northern bank, and the grant of some lands to him as remuneration. The donor mentioned in the previous record, figures in this also.

cells.location: Periya-korukkai, Lalgudi taluk, Trichinopoly district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north wall of the Sundarēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Ends of lines are built in. Seems to register a gift of land by Teṅkaṇarāyan to the Bhaṭṭas of Sirrambalach-chaturvēdimagalam, in response to the representation made by Nallanāṅgai.

cells.location: Periya-korukkai, Lalgudi taluk, Trichinopoly district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of the Sundarēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Records that Sōkan Maṅgalamāṇikkan Teṅkaṇarāyan conferred the appointment of temple-watchman on Sōkan-Māraṉ and endowed some lands for his maintenance. Built in at the end. Seems to register a gift of land for conducting the [Tripūjā] festival.

cells.location: Periya-korukkai, Lalgudi taluk, Trichinopoly district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the base of the wall of the Sundarēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: A few letters at the end of each line are lost. Manštions that a certain Talaichchādeyan of Kuṟuṅkai erected a shrine and installed an image of Vighnēśvara therein. Fragment. Seems to record a rēkōpari sēli of land as dēvadāna to meet the expenses of the temple.

cells.location: Periya-korukkai, Lalgudi taluk, Trichinopoly district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a stone built into the maṇḍapa of the Sundarēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: In modern characters. States that the maṇḍapa was constructed by one Ayyan-Malaimaruyar

cells.location: Periya-korukkai, Lalgudi taluk, Trichinopoly district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On another stone built into the maṇḍapa of the Sundarēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: The bottom of the dagger and the crescent are engraved at the foot. Seems to be a Tamil record dated in the 13th century A.D. States that Tīrthēśvarabhaṭṭar ofkaṇḍi-mār-maṅgalam, a hamlet of Kuṟuṅkai and the temple (śirumuraiyol) in it were kept under the protection of the learned [brāhmaṇas] of Añju-nāḍu.

cells.location: Periya-korukkai, Lalgudi taluk, Trichinopoly district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a third stone built into the maṇḍapa of the Sundarēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Seems to record a provision made by a Vellaḷa resident of Kuṟuṅkai in Rājasārya-vaṉādu, to meet the expenses of the festival on the day of the Tiruvādirai in Vaikāśi in the temple of 'Urokkahōrvi Sokkanāthasvāmi.

cells.location: Periya-korukkai, Lalgudi taluk, Trichinopoly district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a stone set up in front of the Iḷakshmīnārāyaṇa-Perumāḷ temple in the same village (as Sundarēśvara temple). †
cells.remarks: Incomplete at setters. Seems to record a gift of 30 ikkuṟi, (vattu) for maintaining a sacred lamp before the deity. Records a gift of land at Paḷaiyūr in Dippiriyur-nādu by the chief of the nādu, a certain Naḷḷarappatiyar for providing for the sacred bath and offerings to the god Viru-mavanāthanr-aוvamyār at Tiruppuḍavūr.

cells.location: Periya-korukkai, Lalgudi taluk, Trichinopoly district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a stone lying near the Iḷakshmīnārāyaṇa-Perumāḷ temple. †
cells.remarks: Modern. States that the construction of the temple was begun in Kiḷaka Kārttikai 28 and completed on the 21st Vaiyāsi of Saumya by Tirunaimai-Reddiyar, Koṇḍama-Reddiyar, and Kuppa-Settiydr and that the god was consecrated in it on Āvaṇi 21. The inscription also registers a gift of land made to the temple for the merit of Pappu-Reddiyar-Ayyam.

cells.location: Periya-korukkai, Lalgudi taluk, Trichinopoly district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On another stone lying near the Iḷakshmīnārāyaṇa-Perumāḷ temple. †

cells.location: Periya-korukkai, Lalgudi taluk, Trichinopoly district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a stone set up in the village of Paiṇilaiyūr, same taluk and district. †
cells.date:
Śaka 1546, Rak­tākshi, Rishabha, su. dvitīyā, Rohiṇī, Saturday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 278: Śāka 1546, Raktākshi, Rishabha, ba. dvitīyā, Rohiṇī, Saturday  
= A.D. 1624, May 8, Saturday; f.d.t. ·94; ·43.]

cells.location: Edumalai, Lalgudi taluk, Trichinopoly district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the base of the north and west walls of the central shrine in the Krishṇasvāmi temple

cells.location: Edumalai, Lalgudi taluk, Trichinopoly district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a stone set up in the cattle-stand of the village of Paiṇilaiyūr. †
cells.remarks: In modern characters. States that the stone was set up for the merit of Manulita l'appn-Redđi.

cells.location: Tirunārā-yanapuram, Mosiri taluk, Trichinopoly district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south base of the central shrine in the Vadanāyaka-Perumāḷ temple
cells.remarks: Stone lost in the middle. Seems to register a gift of land by Kumāru-Vehkatapati, to the god Vedanayakapperuma!.

cells.location: Tirunāra-yaṇapuram, Mosiri taluk, Trichinopoly district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of the Sundarēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to register the provision made by Mu.piralu Sēnapati-Bhattāṇ for offerings to the god Vedanayakapperuma! on the day of Keṭtai.

cells.place: On the north base of the maṇḍapa in front of the same shrine.
cells.remarks: States that the well in the first prākāra of the temple was the gift of Vedanaynka-Taṭṭāṇ.

cells.place: On the south base of the same maṇḍapa.
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of land, free of taxes, to the Bhaṭṭas of Vana-dīyarch-oḷatturvadiyāḷam by Uyyakkondapiḷḷai uḷias Vandarāyar, a carpenter of Mījalai-kurram, a village within the jurisdiction of the temple of the god Vada-nāyakapperumāḷ at Rājanārāyaṇan Tirunārāyaṇapuram in Aḷakarai-nāḍu, a division of Vaḍakarai Rājarāja-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.location: Dharmavaram — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north base of the maṇḍapa in front of the shrine in the Vedaṇāyaka-Perumāḷ temple. †
cells.remarks: Very much damaged.

cells.location: Kunu-turti — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south base of the maṇḍapa in front of the shrine in the Vedaṇāyaka-Perumāḷ temple. †
cells.remarks: Very much damaged. Seems to refer to the Western Chalukya dynasty and a Vaiśya by name Rāmi-Seṭṭi.

cells.location: Kunu-turu †
cells.place: On slab set up in front of the Mailāra temple at Kurlapalli, hamlet of Kunuturti.
cells.date:
Śaka 1459, Honna-lambi, Bhadrapadu, ha. 3, Thursday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 287: Śāka 1459, Hemalaṁbi, Bhādrapada, ba. 3, Thursday  
= A.D. 1537, August 23, Thursday; ·51. The nak. was Revatī which was current till ·63 of the day.]
cells.remarks: Records a grant of some land (p) by the reddis and the village-people of Kurubahaḷḷi for worship and offerings in the temple of Mayilāndēvara for the merit of Nāg-appayya, the agent of Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Śaṅkaradēva Paḍiḍa-yūma, yādava-Mahārāja.

cells.location: Kunu-turu †
cells.place: On a boulder about a mile to the east of Daḍulūru.
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Seems to record a grant of land as daśa-vandha-mānya by the chief to Māya-Reddi, son of Joṭulamu-[ḍi]-Reddi of Daḍulūru and to Poṭi-Reddi, son of Nāgi-Reddi. The chief is said to have been the son of Ven-kaṭapati-Nāyuḍu and grand-son of Kōneṭi-Nāyuḍu.

cells.place: On the boulder about a mile to the east of Daḍulūru †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to register the grant of 4 tim of land as daśavandha.

cells.location: Kunu-turu †
cells.place: In the place about a mile to the east of Daḍulūru. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. States that Yabana, son of Rājari Kanya-dharu Chennappa, dug a canal from the Nagalēri-obarevu of Daḍulūru and records the grant of a ṭām of land as tank to two individuals.

cells.location: Kunu-turti
cells.place: In the place about a mile to the east of Daḍulūru. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. States that this is a record for the grant of a mānya for constructing the canal from the tank.

cells.location: Kunu-turu †
cells.place: On a slab lying in a field to the north of the village Volaturti.
cells.remarks: Damaged and fragmentary.

cells.location: Kunu-turu †
cells.place: On a boulder called Bōgavaṇigundu in the reserve forest about 1½ miles from Kōnyampalli, the seat of Koṭṭalam-gāripalle.
cells.remarks: States that this marks the boundary between the lands belonging to the villages Māchasamudra-agrahāra and Maṭṭakaṭṭe-agrahāra.

cells.location: Kōnyampalle
cells.place: On a slab lying in front of the ruined Hanuman temple
cells.date:
Śaka 1471, Kilaka, Pushya, ba. 30, Sunday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 294: Śāka 1471, Kilaka, Pushya, ba. 30, Sunday  
= A.D. 1548, December 30, Sunday; amāvāsyā was current till ·07 of the day and the nakshatra was Uttarāshāḍha which was current till ·75.]
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to register the grant of an agrahāra divided into erittas to several brahmans.

cells.location: San-gala
cells.place: On a broken slab lying in front of the Durgamma shrine
cells.remarks: Incomplete and damaged. Seems to record grants of land to several brahmans in the village Sīhala which is said to have been otherwise known as Vijayōhīpali-puram and situated in the Chitra-magani, a division of Guṭṭi-rājya.

cells.location: San-gala †
cells.place: On a broken slab lying in a field to the west of the village Obula-puram.
cells.remarks: Fragmentary and damaged.

cells.location: San-gala †
cells.place: On a slab lying in front of the Chennakēśavasvāmi temple on the banks of the Chitravati out-side the village of Dampetla.
cells.date:
Śaka 1474, Pārī-dhavi, Phālguṇa, śu. 12, Sunday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 297: Śāka 1474, Paridhāvi, Phālguna, śu. 12, Sunday  
= A.D. 1553, February 25, Saturday; ·27; the nak. was Āslēsha which was current till ·78 of the day. The week-day cited in the inscription is probably an error.]
cells.remarks: Records the grant by Kadiri Nāyaka, Nirumala-Nāyaka and Muṇḍi-Nāyaka, the sons of Mahānayakāchārya Kadiri-Nāyaka, of the land attached to the kōḍi right in the temple of Śrī-Chintāmaninātha at Madhurapura for worship and offerings in the temple.

cells.location: San-gala †
cells.place: On a black stone set up in the com-pound of the temple of Chenna-kēśava at Madhurāpuram, a depopulated hamlet of Dampetla.
cells.date: Śaka 1[1]47, Tāraṇa, Māgha, śu. 10, Tuesday. Śu. 10 in Māgha month in the Śaka year 1147 was current on Monday (not Tuesday) i.e., 20th January, 1225 A.D. But, if śu. was a mistake for ba., then the equivalent would be A.D. 1225, February 4, Tuesday. In the absence of the nakshatra, the date cannot be verified. [from date-calculation appendix, No. 298]
cells.remarks: Registers a grant of land by a certain cavalier (who bears a number of birudas) to the Maninātha of the temple of Śrī Alaba-Perumāḷadēva, for the merit of the king.

cells.location: San-gala †

cells.remarks: Incomplete and damaged. Seems to record a grant to the temple of Chennakēśavadēva of Madhurāpura by a private individual (name lost).

cells.location: Mushtūru †

cells.location: Nidugallu †
cells.place: On a rock near the tank-bund in the village of ohaḍi. †

cells.location: Taḍimari †
cells.place: On a slab built into the basement of the dhvajastambha in the fort. †
cells.remarks: Much damaged.

cells.place: On a boulder in a street in the same village.
cells.remarks: Very much damaged.

cells.location: Tange-ḍa, Palnad taluk, Guntur district † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab built into the wall in front of the Hanumān temple near the fort-gate in the same village (as Vēṇugōpālasvāmin temple). †
cells.remarks: Records the remission of some of the taxes on the varbara of the Taṅgēda-sīma at the request of the barbere Koṇḍōju and Timmoju by Mahamaṇḍalēśvara Rāmarāju Rāmayyadēva-Mahārāja and Tirumallayyadēva-Mahārāja, who were called the supporters of the king's empire. This was published with reference to the order of the king's chiefs by Dāsaraju Veṅkaṭādri-rāju in the Tangēḍa-sīma and in all the provinces. The names of some of the taxes that were remitted are also enumerated.

cells.location: Tange-ḍa, Palnad taluk, Guntur district † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a stone built into another gate of the fort. †
cells.remarks: Records the grant of land by the inhabitants of the 44 villages to two individuals (name lost) for having defended the fort-gate (during some attack).

cells.location: Tange-ḍa, Palnad taluk, Guntur district † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On another stone built into another gate of the fort in the same village (as Hanumān temple). †
cells.date:

Vīrapratāpa Rudradēva-Gajapati.
Śaka 1431, Sukla, Mārgaśīra, śu. 7, Monday
= A.D. 1509, December 8, Monday; ba. 7 was current the whole day and ended at ·04 the next day; śu. is evidently a mistake for ba.]
cells.remarks: Damaged and broken. Mentionis Bodadapa, Immadi..., Mahāpatra and Khāna-Vodaya and the stone fort-gate (pavini).

cells.place: On a slab set up in front of the deserted temple of Sitārāmasvāmini in the fort. †
cells.remarks: Records the exemption from taxation of the vrittis belonging to the Brāhmaṇas in the Tangēda-sīma by Muddugajalēśvara Nandikēśa-Mahārāja-Ayyagāru who was governing the Tangēda-sīma under Sadāśiva-rāya. The inscription was engraved by Pāpi-Nēningāru, the agent of the governor.

cells.location: Tange-ḍa, Palnad taluk, Guntur district † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On another slab in front of the deserted temple of Sitārāmasvāmini in the fort in the same village (as temple of Sitārāmasvāmini). †
cells.date: Śaka 1471, [Kīlaka], Vaiśākha, śu. 16, Sunday, lunar eclipse. [date-calculation appendix, No. 377: Śāka 1471, [Kilaka], Vaiśākha, śu. 15, Sunday, lunar eclipse = A.D. 1548, April 22, Sunday. There was a lunar eclipse on this day.]
cells.remarks: Registers the grant at the instance of Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Rāmarāju Viṭhalayadēva-Mahārāja of the village Kahu-varam in the Taṅgēda-sīma for worship and offerings to the god Śrī-Lakshminarasimha of Tangēda by Mahāmaṇḍ-alēśvara Appalādēvi-Mahādēvi, wife of Somarāju-viniyaka-chonda-Mahārāja, and grandson of Somayajula-dēvōda-Mahārāja of the solar race. The village is said to have been in the sima granted to the donor as nāyankara by Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Rāmadēva-Mahārāja.

cells.location: Tange-ḍa, Palnad taluk, Guntur district † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab set up before the western gate of the fort. †
cells.remarks: Records the noonetruet on this date of the temples of Gōpālasvāmi, Raghunāthaka, Hanumanta, Rāma, Kālabhairava, Vīrēśvara and other god at Tangēda which had been without worship since the year Kilaka. By the chief (Vā. . . . Chandrasekhara), by whom the renovation of the trail (i.e. of the temple) of Tangēda and the celebration of the brahmotsava in the temples of Gōpālasvāmin and Vīrēśvara at the request of the sthānākaram Taṭigeda Sōrappa and Kichchana.

cells.location: Tange-ḍa, Palnad taluk, Guntur district † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On another slab set up before the western gate of the fort in the same village (as temple of Sitārāmasvāmini). †
cells.remarks: Records the renewal of the utsa-tirunal festival of the god Gōpālasvamin of Tangēda which had been in abeyance since the year Akshaya, previous to the date of the inscription, by Surappa Kiohobana of Tangēda with the help of the two individuals (name lost).

cells.location: Tange-ḍa, Palnad taluk, Guntur district † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab set up in the reserve forest about a mile to the west of Kottapalle, hamlet of Perur. †
cells.date:
Komaragiri Redđi [date-calculation appendix, No. 380: Śaka 1313, Prajāpati, Mārgaśīra, ba. 10, Monday.
On December 21, A.D. 1391, the tithi was ba. 10·41, but the week-day was Thursday, and not Monday. December 18 and December 25 were Mondays, but the tithis of those days were ba. 7 and ba. 14 respectively.]
cells.remarks: Records the construction of a temple and the consecration of the image of Śri-Narasimha at Anuttagini near the confluence of the Varthāngadame and Bhavanāśi to the south of the Krishṇavēni as the result of a vision he had of the god, by Chokkana Singaṇgāru who was governing Tangēda under the king, and who also set up shrines for the Garuḍalvar and Hanumanlantarvar and consecrated them according to the āgamas and grants of land in various villages.

cells.location: Tange-ḍa, Palnad taluk, Guntur district † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a stone lying on the banks of the Krishna near the same village (as temple of Sitārāmasvāmini). †
cells.remarks: Records the construction of steps leading to the Krishṇa-veṇu on this date by Maṇḍali Gōpinēqu, son of Kaţinōdu.

cells.location: Tange-ḍa, Palnad taluk, Guntur district † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a pillar in the temple of Bogga-Mallappa on the banks of the Krishna near the same village (as temple of Sitārāmasvāmini). †
cells.remarks: Completely damaged.

cells.remarks: Completely damaged.

cells.location: Tange-ḍa, Palnad taluk, Guntur district † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On another stone lying near the Hanumān temple. †
cells.remarks: Records the consecration of the image of Nandikōvara, and the construction of a maṇdapa before the god Papana-sanadēva by Mellipeddi Tippana.

cells.location: Tange-ḍa, Palnad taluk, Guntur district † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a third stone lying near the Hanumān temple. †
cells.remarks: Mentions Tippana, son of Appa-Ojjhulu of Vedu||acheruvu.

cells.location: Tange-ḍa, Palnad taluk, Guntur district † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a stone lying near the temple of Ellamma at Barangupalle, a deserted hamlet of Tangeda.
cells.date: Śaka 1560, Vikrama, Kārtika, ba. 5, Saturday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 386: Śāka 1562, Vikrama, Kārttika, ba. 5, Saturday = A.D. 1640, October 24, Saturday. Ba. 5 was current the whole day and ended at ·02 the next day. Nak. Ārdrā continued till ·72 on Saturday.]
cells.remarks: Records the setting up of the goddess Āśavani Yallamma in the temple of fevera and the grant of land for the worship of the deities, by Achchēni Papaya with the permission of Vanigala and Pepi-Reddi at the request of Damarla Rangappa-Nāyadu.

cells.location: Tange-ḍa, Palnad taluk, Guntur district † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab lying in the temple of Gampala Ramalingēśvarasvāmi in the same village (as temple of Ellamma). †
cells.remarks: Records the grant by the people of the eighteen samayas and the nānādēśis of jangala of a proportion of the customs-duties at the place for the worship and offerings to the god Gampala Ramalingēśvara. The grant was made in the presence of Ivari-Nayanāru-gāru, son of Macbuya-Nayanāru-gāru.

cells.location: Tange-ḍa, Palnad taluk, Guntur district † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the slab in the Reddi garuḍastambha in the Vēṇu-gōpālasvāmi temple †
cells.date: Śaka 1268, Dhātu, Āshādha, śu. 15, Monday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 388: Śāka 1258, Dhātu, Āshāḍha, śu. 15, Monday = A.D. 1336, June 24, Monday ; ·85; the nak. was Pūrvāshāḍhā which was current till ·80 of the day.]
cells.remarks: Records the grant of 24 sheep by Kāya-Bhattundu, son of Gala Kētiboya, to the temple of Ghaṇṭāla Rāmanāthadēva for the merit of his parents. The grazing fees (pulari) for these sheep and the illari (house-tax) due from the herdsmen who tended them were remitted by the Bolli-Peddaru according to the orders of Tāngēḍa Maḍala-Nayanāru-gāru who was the chief of the region.

cells.location: Tange-ḍa, Palnad taluk, Guntur district † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab lying in the Vīrabhadra temple in the same village (as Vēṇu-gōpālasvāmi temple). †
cells.date: Śaka 1818, Khara, Chaitra, śu. 7, Wednesday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 389: Śāka 1313, Khara, Chaitra, śu. 7, Wednesday = A.D. 1391, April 15, Wednesday ; ·61. On this day nak. Ārdrā ended at ·04 and then ‘Punarvasu’ commenced.]
cells.remarks: Records the reconstruction of the temple of Nīlakaṇṭhadēvara and Vīrabhadra at Tāngēḍa and the provision made for their several images in it with due consideration for their worship by grant of lands by a certain Jōgayya. Recounts the vicissitudes of the temple which had originally been built by Surasuru and Kichchara.

cells.location: Pullareḍḍigudem, Palnad taluk, Guntur district † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab lying in the ruined Śiva temple within the fort on the Nagarjunikonda hill
cells.date: Śaka 1413, Viro-dhikrit, Magha, su. 13, Friday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 390: Śāka 1413, Virddhikrit, Māgha, śu. 13, Friday = A.D. 1492, January 12, Thursday ; ·69. The week-day or the tithi quoted in the inscription is probably a mistake.]
cells.remarks: States that Sarvarāju, son of Paramarāju of the Kauṇḍinya-gōtra, constructed the stone temple with golden pinnacles over it for the god Nāgēśvaraliṅga at Nagarjunikonda and that the worship and offerings of the god he presented half of the village ... (the record refers to the sahasrādāna made during a kālar ēclipse). By Singarayya for the merit of his father Vīramarāju.

cells.location: Pullareḍḍigudem, Palnad taluk, Guntur district † — Andhra Pradesh

cells.remarks: Records the gift of a pillar by Chaniśiri (?), the sister of the king, to the chaitya enshrining a dhātu of Samasambuddha.

cells.remarks: Registers a grant of land by the general Rayapaṭka-sahini Dāji Virayanayankulu to the temple of ... iśvara.

cells.location: Katteragaṇḍa, Badvel taluk, Cuddapah district — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a wall of the maṇḍapa of the Chennakēśavasvāmi temple

cells.location: Katteragaṇḍa, Badvel taluk, Cuddapah district † — Andhra Pradesh

cells.location: Palugallapalle, Badvel taluk †
cells.place: On a slab lying near the ruined temple of Bhairava, on a hillock two miles to the east of the same village (as Śiva temple). †
cells.remarks: Records a grant of written on a land by Bindaaraju Lakkaya-nna-Mahādēva-Maharaju, who were gov-erning Sakali Peddakoduru, to the grantee of worship in the temple of Bhairavam on the hill, which worship was repaired by a certain Avubhalanathha with the understanding that those cultivating or raising a garden on the land should pay to the temple some portion of the produce

cells.location: Midutūru, Nandikotkur taluk, Kurnool district — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab set up in the prākāra of the Chennakēśavasvāmin temple
cells.remarks: Records a grant of some land by Mahamaṇḍalēśvara Koṁyadavūru-Mahārāja of Sōma-vaṁśa and the Ātrēya-gōtra to the god Śrī-Chennakēśanya of Miduturu for the daily worship and offerings to the god. Records also the grant of a flower garden and land to the same donor. The village Midutūru is said to be an amaram granted by the king to the chief, whose ancestry for four generations is given.

cells.location: Midutūru, Nandikotkur taluk, Kurnool district † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a second slab set up in the prākāra of the Chennakēśavasvāmin temple. †

cells.location: Siddhâpur † — Karnataka
cells.place: On a slab lying in front of the Sivamedaya in the same village (as Hanuman temple). †
cells.date: Śaka 1068, Ânanda, Paushya, amâvâsya, Sunday, solar eclipse.
cells.remarks: Records the grant of two… by Hallagauda to the Múlasthânadeva of Hosavolal.

cells.location: Siddhâpur † — Karnataka
cells.place: On the pedestal of the image of Bhagavati in the Hanuman temple †
cells.remarks: Records the setting up of the image of the goddess Bhagavati of Śrî-Muigalbâdênadeva.

cells.location: Siddhâpur † — Karnataka

cells.location: Siddhâpur †
cells.place: On a slab set up in front of the Siddhēśvara temple in the same village (as Hanuman temple). †
cells.remarks: Registers the grant of a field and materials for the renewal of the temple of Prabhuliṅgadēva of Hosavoḷala and for the worship of god by the prominent citizens and the five hundred tontigas (i.e., gardeners) of Hosavoḷala.

cells.location: Siddhâpur †
cells.place: On the pedestal of the image of god Kēśava in Gugikatti.
cells.date: Chāḷukya-Vikrama year 49, Krōdhi, Vaiśākha, ba. 4, Sunday.
cells.remarks: States that Maiḷaladēvi, the queen of Jayakēśi, consecrated god Kēśava at Gugikaṭṭi.

cells.location: Nigadi
cells.place: On a slab set up in front of the Kalamēśvara temple on the tank-bund
cells.remarks: Records the grant of a field near the tank Hirekeri to Tējōrāśi-Paṇḍita by Bauṇḍa-Gauṇḍa of Nigundi (modern Nigadi) for the consecration of god Śrī-Mūlasthānadēva.

cells.location: Wigadi †
cells.place: On a hero-stone at Bammarasikoppa, a deserted village near Nigadi.
cells.remarks: Records the grant of a field near the tank Hirekeri to Tējōrāśi-Paṇḍita by Bauṇḍa-Gauṇḍa of Nigundi (modern Nigadi) for the consecration of god Śrī-Mūlasthānadēva.

cells.location: Alnavar
cells.place: On a hero-stone set up in a field of the Liṅgāyata-Maṭha
cells.remarks: Records the death of Chikka-Malliseṭṭi, a saint of Hubbaḷḷi, and states that his body was cremated on the bank of the river.

cells.location: Alna-var †
cells.place: On a broken slab in front of the Kalamēśvara temple in the same village.
cells.remarks: The stone is broken in the beginning and the end.

cells.location: Alna-var †
cells.place: On a slab lying on a raised plinth of the Jumma-Masjid in Pyati street in the same village (as Jumma-Masjid). †
cells.remarks: Registers the grant of a land to a Jaina basti at Aḷṇavar by Narasiṅgayya-Seṭṭi.

cells.location: Alna-var †
cells.place: On a hero-stone lying in the compound of the Barugundi house.
cells.remarks: The stone is much damaged and broken at the end.

cells.location: Talipparamba, Chirakkal taluk, Malabar district — Kerala
cells.place: On a stone built into the west wall of the bathing shed of the Āśramattu-chira (tank)
cells.date: Kollam 706, Makaram 3, Jupiter in Mīnam, Kali day (expressed by chronogram dugdham śuddhi hētukam) 1689598.
cells.remarks: Records the completion of this tank on this day. Contains a reflection on the necessity for performing good deeds in this life.

cells.location: Talip-paramba, Chirakkal taluk, Malabar district † — Kerala
cells.place: On a stone built into the platform under the banyan tree near the bank of Asra. †
cells.remarks: States that the platform was built by Śēkharaṉ of Paṭṭaṅkoḍam.

cells.location: Talip-paramba, Chirakkal taluk, Malabar district † — Kerala
cells.place: On a slab set up in the court-yard of the Nārāyaṇakannur temple, Ramaṇtali, same taluk and district. †
cells.remarks: Records that Muṇḍaṉ Koṟṟaḍai of Maṇattuṇai purchased from Nambiyār Vikkirama-Rāma a field called Ayiṉi in Kaviyalppuram and gave it to the temple of god Narasiṅga-Viṇṇagar-Dēvar for maintaining a perpetual lamp and for providing offerings. The trading corporation called maṇigrāmattār of Iḷaṅgōppaṭṭaṇam were in charge of the endowment.

cells.location: Talip-paramba, Chirakkal taluk, Malabar district † — Kerala
cells.place: On the front tier of the same tem-ple.
cells.date: Kali day (expressed by the chronogram dharēddhōguru-mukhya) 1523929.
cells.remarks: States that some images were made for the temple on the day mentioned.

cells.location: Kannapuram, Chirakkal taluk, Malabar district † — Kerala
cells.place: On a slab in the south side of the prâkâra in the Kuruvakkavu tem-ple
cells.remarks: Mentions the several pieces of land which were set apart for the offerings and the lamp, in the temple of Tiruk-kapparnuttu-Dêvar. A certain Udayavaiñar alias Ramakuda-maver figures in the inscription.

cells.location: Tiruvadur, Chirakkal taluk, Malabar district † — Kerala
cells.place: On a slab lying in the compound of te temple
cells.remarks: Beginning and end lost. States that twenty-four persons whose names have been mentioned, were to be responsible for the management of the temple lands and that they were to measure out paddy for the expenses of the temple.

cells.location: Tiruvadur, Chirakkal taluk, Malabar district † — Kerala
cells.place: On the threshold of the Nārāyaṇakannur temple. †
cells.remarks: Beginnings of lines lost. The purpose of the inscription is not clear. Peruntaṭṭap and his brother Ijaiya-Nārayapan Kalaṇ are referred to in the Sanskrit portion as the goldsmiths of the Musbika king (?).

cells.location: Painkannur, Kuttippuram taluk, Malabar district ‡ — Kerala
cells.place: On the south side of the passage to the Subrahmanya temple
cells.remarks: Fragmentary and damaged.

cells.location: Painkannur, Kuttippuram taluk, Malabar district ‡ — Kerala
cells.place: On the north side of the same passage.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Registers some transaction made by the assembly of Paidkannur, in connection with the burning of a perpetual lamp in the temple.
